senses.gloss: m. (denom. of קָאָה, with ref. to the effusion of semen) one having abnormally large testicles.
units: Bekh. 44ᵇ משובן זה הק׳ (Ar. קיק) m’shubban is the ḳayyan.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ בבצים</he> (Ar. <he>בעל קיק</he>) ḳ. refers to the testicles; v. <cite ref="C01241"><he>גְּרַבְתָּן</he></cite>.
